learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how to design bright, bold, and powerful posters that share important ideas with the whole world!

main_concepts.concept_title: 📢 The Power of a Clear Message
main_concepts.simple_explanation: A poster needs to tell people something important very quickly. We use a short, catchy sentence called a slogan so people can read it fast.
Words on a poster should be big and thick! We can draw bubble letters or block letters and color them brightly so they stand out from far away.
Instead of lots of small drawings, a poster uses one big, powerful picture. For example, a giant green tree is a great symbol for saving nature.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design a Save Water Poster!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a large sheet of paper. Draw a big water drop, write SAVE WATER in thick colorful bubble letters, and hang it near your bathroom sink!

quick_recap: ⭐ Posters use big pictures and short words to share ideas quickly.
⭐ Thick and bold lettering helps people read the message from a distance.
⭐ Choosing bright contrasting colors makes your poster eye-catching.
